_comment: Cau hinh dong san vao bo cai DF Agent - CAN TO / IN-OUT (khoi SEND OVER 6 cua workbook '5.Semiauto- lockmove SEND OVER6 - delta-stable-final-221.xlsm'). Vai tro DUY NHAT: nhan lenh OUT/IN tu man hinh /weighing-station-large roi day ma rack sang ung dung pha mau bang mo phong CHUOT + CLIPBOARD, y het cach VBA goc lam. Ban nay KHONG doc can, KHONG in tem.
_comment_vi_sao_bo_cai_rieng: Vi hai viec doi hai CACH CHAY khac han nhau. Doc can hop voi Windows Service: tu chay khi bat may, khong can ai dang nhap. IN/OUT thi KHONG THE la service: Windows tu Vista co 'session 0 isolation' - tien trinh cua service nam o session 0, rieng biet voi phien dang nhap cua tho, nen SetCursorPos/mouse_event ban vao desktop cua session 0 va clipboard cung la clipboard rieng cua window station do; ung dung pha mau ben phien nguoi dung khong bao gio nhan duoc gi. Te hon la no van 'thanh cong' tren giay (SetClipboardText tra ve true) nen Agent ack DONE trong khi thuc te chua dan duoc ma nao. Excel VBA lam duoc chinh vi Excel chay ngay trong phien nguoi dung - nen ban nay cung chay dung nhu vay.
_comment_cach_chay: MSI KHONG cai service. No dat shortcut o Startup (All Users) va Start Menu; Agent chay bang chinh tai khoan dang dang nhap, cua so console thu nho tren thanh tac vu. Cai xong lan dau: bam Start Menu > DF Local Agent > 'DF Local Agent (Can to - IN OUT)' de chay ngay, cac lan sau tu chay luc dang nhap. Tho lo tat cua so thi mo lai bang dung shortcut do (man hinh se bao 'Agent tren may tram CHUA lay lenh' nen biet ngay).
_comment_chung_ma_tram: Workstation:Id de trong + ScaleKind=LARGE => ma tram tu sinh la 'WS-LARGE-<TEN MAY>', TRUNG KHIT voi ma cua bo cai nhan can tren cung may. Bat buoc phai trung: man hinh gui lenh rack theo ma tram no dang dung (lay tu /api/workstations/whoami?kind=LARGE), neu hai Agent ra hai ma khac nhau thi lenh xep vao mot hang doi ma khong ai lay. TUYET DOI khong dien Workstation:Id rieng cho ban nay.
_comment_service: Chi de dat ten trong log cho de doc - ban nay khong cai service nao.
_comment_role: Role=RACK_ONLY -> Worker tat CA hai vong lap doc can va lay lenh in (_scaleEnabled/_printEnabled deu false), chi con bao danh 60 giay mot lan va vong lay lenh rack. Nho vay cai chung may voi bo nhan can khong sinh ra hai nguon so can danh nhau. Backend (AgentAuth) coi RACK_ONLY nhu SCALE_ONLY khi tu dang ky tram, de tram van duoc cap capability LARGE_SCALE du ban nay bao danh truoc.
_comment_scale: Khong doc can, nhung ReadIntervalMs van la nhip cua vong lap chinh nen de 250ms thay vi 10ms - khong co gi de doc thi khong can quay nhanh.
_comment_rack: Toa do lay nguyen tu VBA goc (ModAPI_mouse/Mod_sendRackauto): OUT = cho 150 -> click (10,100) kich hoat cua so -> cho 220 -> click (365,680) mo vung nhap -> cho 200 -> [6 lan: dat clipboard, click o, Ctrl+V, cho 200] -> click (750,215) xac nhan. IN = cho 150 -> click (10,100) -> cho 220 -> click (750,430). Nut xac nhan cua IN KHAC nut cua OUT.
_comment_rack_hieu_chinh: DAY LA TOA DO MAN HINH TUYET DOI cua may hieu chinh goc, KHONG phai toa do trong cua so. PHAI do lai tren chinh may nay truoc khi cho tho dung that, neu khong la dan vao cua so bat ky. Cach do: mo ung dung pha mau, dua chuot vao dung o can click, chay trong PowerShell: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position. Sua xong thi khoi dong lai Agent (dong cua so console roi bam lai shortcut).
_comment_rack_6o: PHAI gui du 6 o KE CA o rong - VBA goc lam vay de XOA gia tri con sot cua lo truoc ben ung dung dich. Bo qua o rong la cap nham vat tu khi lo sau it rack hon lo truoc.
_comment_rack_tam_tat: Muon tam khoa IN/OUT: doi Enabled ve false roi khoi dong lai Agent. Tho van con nut COPY tren man hinh de chep lo 1 ra clipboard va dan tay sang he pha mau.
